name: I/O Image
summary: Adversaries may seek to capture process values related to the inputs and outputs of a PLC. During the scan cycle, a PLC reads the status of all inputs and stores them in an image table. The image table is the PLCs internal storage location where values of inputs/outputs for one scan are stored while it executes the user program. analytics.name: Analytic 1906
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies a single Industrial Control System (ICS) protocol session reading the complete Input/Output (I/O) image from a field device, rather than the sparse, fixed tag subset that legitimate Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) polling queries, from a source not in the approved control server list. OT operational-fidelity gate: Do not alert on novelty, scan/read volume, or enumeration alone. Alert when the source role is not authorized for discovery/polling and the target scope, address/tag range, protocol, or rate deviates from the established operational baseline. Suppress normal SCADA/HMI/historian polling, commissioning, asset inventory, backup,…
